assertions.title: Docker Sandbox Executes Target Binary in Isolated Container

steps.expected: Method calls DockerSandbox.execute(), not legacy host-OS methods (powershell/wmic)
steps.observed: _monitor_behavior() calls self._sandbox.execute(binary_path, timeout_seconds=...) — confirmed. No legacy _monitor_file_operations/_monitor_memory_operations etc. are invoked in the main code path.

steps.expected: Docker container created (docker run with --name reveng-sandbox-*), no powershell/wmic calls
steps.observed: subprocess.Popen called once with ['docker', 'run', '--rm', '--network=none', '--name', 'reveng-sandbox-f0bbe9328428', '-v', '...sample.exe:/target:ro', 'reveng-python:3.11-slim-strace', 'sh', '-lc', '...']. subprocess.run called once with ['docker', 'image', 'inspect', 'reveng-python:3.11-slim-strace']. Zero powershell/wmic calls.

steps.action: Call stop_monitoring() and verify container cleanup
steps.expected: DockerSandbox.stop() issues docker stop + docker rm -f for the container
steps.observed: DockerSandbox.stop() called subprocess.run with ['docker', 'stop', 'reveng-sandbox-test123abc'] and ['docker', 'rm', '-f', 'reveng-sandbox-test123abc']. Container fully removed.

summary: Tested 1 assertion (VAL-ADV-001): PASSED. BehavioralMonitor.start_monitoring() routes execution through DockerSandbox.execute() which creates a Docker container (docker run --rm --network=none --name reveng-sandbox-*). Zero subprocess calls with 'powershell' or 'wmic' arguments were made during the monitoring flow. DockerSandbox.stop() correctly issues docker stop + docker rm -f to clean up the container.
